summary: TOOL-1 Login with valid and invalid credentials
description:
As a customer, I want to sign in so I can access my account.

* Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
* Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
* Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.
* Password field masks the input.

criteria.text: Valid email and password → redirected to the account page, and the user's name shows in the navigation.
Wrong password → an error message appears and the user stays on the login page.
Empty fields → each shows a required-field validation message.

cases.title: Sign in with a valid email and password
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email and password> exists. Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter <the registered account's email> in the email field.
Enter <the matching password> in the password field.
cases.expected: The user is redirected to the account page, and the user's name is shown in the navigation.

cases.title: Sign in with a wrong password
cases.preconditions: <a registered customer account with a known email> exists. Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter <the registered account's email> in the email field.
Enter <a password that is not the one for that account> in the password field.
cases.expected: An error message appears (exact text not specified in the story) and the user stays on the login page.

cases.title: Submit the login form with both fields empty
cases.preconditions: Tester is on the login page and not signed in. Both the email and password fields are empty.
cases.expected: A required-field validation message is shown for the email field and a required-field validation message is shown for the password field (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the email field empty
cases.preconditions: Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter <any password value> in the password field.
cases.expected: A required-field validation message is shown for the empty email field (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Submit the login form with only the password field empty
cases.preconditions: Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Enter <any email value> in the email field.
cases.expected: A required-field validation message is shown for the empty password field (exact text not specified in the story).

cases.title: Password field masks the typed input
cases.preconditions: Tester is on the login page and not signed in.
steps: Look at the characters displayed in the password field.
cases.expected: The typed characters are masked rather than shown as readable text.
